title: Ranking configuration
subtitle: Configure how prompts are ranked and scored on the Explore page.
mode.title: Recalculation mode
mode.help: Choose when ranking scores are recalculated.
mode.piggyback_help: Recalculates when users visit /explore. Uses fewer resources; results may be slightly out of date.
mode.scheduled_help: Recalculates in the background at fixed intervals. Uses more resources to keep results fresh.
interval.help: Minimum hours between recalculations (1 = hourly, 168 = weekly).
weights.title: Ranking weights
weights.help: Each metric is multiplied by its weight to produce the final ranking score.
help.users_with_access: Points per user who has access to the prompt.
help.unique_chatters: Points per unique user who chatted.
help.has_landing_boost: Flat bonus for having a landing page.
help.recency_max_bonus: Maximum bonus for new prompts, decreasing linearly over 90 days.
weights.change_help: Changing weights will affect prompt positioning after the next recalculation.
formula.title: Formula preview
formula.help: Current scoring formula with live weights:
defaults_restored: Defaults restored. Save to apply them.
error.title: Error
error.save: Unable to save the ranking configuration. Please try again.
recalculation_started: Recalculation started. The last recalculation time will update once it finishes and you reload the page.
error.recalculate: Unable to start recalculation. Please try again.
error.invalid_interval: The interval must be between 1 and 168 hours.
error.invalid_weight: Invalid weight for {metric}. Enter a finite number between 0 and 1000.
error.invalid_request: Invalid configuration. Check the mode, interval and weights.
